kypExtensions.summary: Reading every dyslipidemia as one broken step of the E17 lipid-transport map: step 3 broken = type I (LPL/apo CII), step 7 broken = type II (LDL receptor/apo B100), the apoE return address broken = type III, step 4 overactive = type IV; abetalipoproteinemia = the whole map shut down at MTP assembly.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source presents the four diseases as isolated table rows; unifying them as four single-arrow cuts of the transport circuit (plus the total-failure MTP counterpart) is KYP's integrative model.
